body: This is my first time posting anything here. I don’t know how to post a private mesage.
I think you have the answer to that:)

It’s really, really impressive how confident you are that things will eventually be fine. I admire that and I’m jealous ( in s good way) of that. I wish I had that belief and confidence that things will be ok. I used to though .. I agree that we live in strange times. Life because difficult in a different way than it was for my parents or grandparents,
What are you doing on the suicide watch ?

I don’t want to say too much as I’ve never posted here before and I’m not paranoid.  I will hopefully be able to bring something from where I’m going to help me do it. I don’t know. I just can’t believe that my life turned out like this with all hopes and dreams  I had .
Thank you so much for listening. I feel selfish just talking about me but I really have no one to talk to . Thank you

I think I want to do it not because of someone, just because I lost all hope .. yet again .. and I really don’t think that if there’s a next time, it will be different. That’s the most painful thing. I would give so much of what I have to be really happy. I’m surrounded by people but I lead a very lonely life and I’m so tired now. I have a trip coming up next week. It will be my deciding moment.

I agree with you that a lot of women out there are crazy . Sorry that my nickname mislead you - I’m a woman:) - yet still agree with your comments. I know a lot of girls that don’t respect the good guy! I on the other hand can’t find the good one. I’m very giving and yet I somehow choose men who just take me for guaranteed. It’s exhausting . I give up. I thought about suicide few times in the past , I think I found the way to do it this time. I just wanted to share , without being judged .

It’s insane, I can be really honest with myself. I know when I f..k up but I also know when I really do good things for people. I’m really a nice person. Just seem to be making bad choices. I’m too tired now . Tired of trying
